overview: The big story: US AI lab leaders signed a White House Accord on Super Intelligence, and much of the feed reacted to it. Stripe's Patrick Collison launched the OUSD stablecoin, Coinbase pitched accounts for AI agents, and SpaceX's Starship put its first Starlink V3 satellites in orbit. Note: your interests file is still the blank template, so this ranking is a general tech and markets guess. Fill in config/interests.md for sharper briefs.

top_items.title: Pichai, Zuckerberg: AI labs sign White House Accord on Super Intelligence
top_items.notes:
Top AI lab leaders met Trump and signed the Accord plus a Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities, promising internal controls, audits, testing and red-teaming. Pichai also said Google invested hundreds of billions in the last two years. Worth reading if you hold or watch AI names.
https://x.com/sundarpichai/status/2105121763176894804

top_items.title: Patrick Collison: OUSD stablecoin live, Stripe adopting it
top_items.notes:
Open Standard's new USD stablecoin launched with $400M+ liquidity on Tempo. It offers free 1:1 USD conversion via Coinbase, Mastercard, Stripe and Visa, and shares most yield with partners. Stripe is putting it into core product flows. Growth tracker: ousd.fyi.
https://x.com/patrickc/status/2105321532440625424

top_items.title: David Sacks: Q2 GDP revised up, inflation cooler than expected
top_items.notes:
Q2 GDP was revised to 2.2% (from 1.5%). Core PCE came in at 3.0% vs 3.3% expected, and ADP private jobs at +90k vs about 68k expected. This is a useful macro read for any rate-sensitive positions.
https://x.com/DavidSacks/status/2105317744308879427

top_items.title: Brian Armstrong: Coinbase building accounts for AI agents
top_items.notes:
Coinbase says it is building the financial account for super intelligence: trading, payments and borrowing/lending, with agents getting their own accounts. Its agent trading volume just hit another all-time high, with Grok as the top tool used to drive it.
https://x.com/brian_armstrong/status/2105307393487774153

top_items.title: Elon Musk: Starship puts first 26 Starlink V3 satellites in orbit
top_items.notes:
Flight 14 was the first Starship not kept on a suborbital path, and the V3 satellites made contact. It is a milestone for SpaceX and Starlink. Starlink Mobile also went live in Ecuador.
https://x.com/elonmusk/status/2105118961532596360

top_items.title: Elon Musk: Tesla Roadster demo moved to October 15
top_items.notes:
Tesla postponed the outdoor Roadster event because of high winds. Update your calendar if you were planning to watch.
https://x.com/elonmusk/status/2105090209897500828

top_items.title: Burry Tracker: housing data weakening, Burry warns
top_items.notes:
Rates have risen 6 straight weeks, purchase applications are down 14% year over year, and serious delinquencies are up 19% year over year. Burry is quoted saying AI spending is the only thing holding the economy up. Worth a look if you hold housing or bank exposure.
https://x.com/burrytracker/status/2105294564525310386

top_items.title: Peter Steinberger: Figma restricts MCP; OpenClaw goes enterprise
top_items.notes:
Steinberger calls Figma's MCP restriction silly and easy to get around, and MCP creator David Soria Parra (dsp_) pushed back publicly too. Separately, OpenClaw Enterprise launched with NVIDIA and Red Hat support.
https://x.com/steipete/status/2105325370602135768
